description: The current Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) for an airport: the official 24-30 hour forecast for wind, visibility, weather and cloud at the airfield, decoded into time blocks with plain-English change types (temporary, becoming, 30% chance). Answers "will it be foggy or windy at the airport tomorrow morning". Source: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center (worldwide airports that issue TAFs). Covers the airfield only, not the route; not for flight planning. (cost: 1 credit)

icao.description: string, required, one ICAO airport code (e.g. EGLL)

name: taf_forecast
